nodes.description: UE is not registered with the network.
UE needs to perform initial registration (e.g., power on, emergency, mobility).
UE sent REGISTRATION REQUEST, T3510 running.
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT not requiring REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
UE successfully registered with the network.
UE receives REG ACCEPT via CAG cell, but cell not authorized in updated list.
UE registered but in limited service (e.g., CAG/TAI restricted).
UE receives REG ACCEPT via non-CAG cell, but only CAG access allowed.
UE registered but needs to perform PLMN search (e.g., CAG restriction).
UE receives REG ACCEPT with SOR, attempts service elsewhere, releases connection.
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #3, #6, or #7.
UE deregistered, USIM/entry considered invalid.
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #11 (PLMN not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #12 (TA not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #13 (Roaming not allowed in TA).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #15 (No suitable cells in TA).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #22 (Congestion).
UE deregistered, attempting registration (e.g., after T3511 expiry or reject).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #27 (N1 mode not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #31 (Redirection to EPC required).
UE deregistered, N1 disabled for 3GPP, searching for E-UTRA cell.
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #36 (IAB-node operation not authorized).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #62 (No network slices available).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #72 (Non-3GPP access to 5GCN not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #73 (Serving network not authorized).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #74 (Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #75 (Permanently not authorized for this SNPN).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #76 (Not authorized for this CAG).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #77 (Wireline access area not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #78 (PLMN not allowed at location).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #79 (UAS services not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #80 (Disaster roaming not allowed).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #81 (N3IWF not compatible).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #82 (TNGF not compatible).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT for emergency with cause #5 (PEI not accepted).
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT (abnormal cause) and attempt counter < 5.
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT (abnormal cause) and attempt counter = 5.
Timer T3510 expires and attempt counter < 5.
Timer T3510 expires and attempt counter = 5.
Lower layer failure occurs before response, attempt counter < 5.
Lower layer failure occurs before response, attempt counter = 5.
Current TAI changes before registration procedure completes.
TAI changes after ACCEPT but before COMPLETE, new TAI is in list.
TAI changes after ACCEPT but before COMPLETE, new TAI not in list.
REGISTRATION COMPLETE transmission fails, TAI changes, new TAI is in list.
REGISTRATION COMPLETE transmission fails, TAI changes, new TAI not in list.
REGISTRATION COMPLETE transmission fails, no TAI change.
REGISTRATION REQUEST transmission fails.
Access for localized services in SNPN is no longer allowed.
Timer T3511 expires (retry timer after reject/failure).
Timer T3502 expires (retry timer after max attempts).
AMF has no ongoing 5GMM procedure for the UE.
AMF receives REGISTRATION REQUEST from UE.
AMF is processing the REGISTRATION REQUEST.
AMF accepts registration and expects REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
AMF sent REG ACCEPT requiring COMPLETE, T3550 running.
AMF accepts registration and does not expect REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
AMF considers the UE registered.
AMF receives REGISTRATION COMPLETE from UE.
AMF rejects the registration request.
Lower layer failure occurs while AMF waits for REGISTRATION COMPLETE (T3550 running).
Timer T3550 expires (1st-4th time).
Timer T3550 expires (5th time).
AMF receives new REG REQUEST (different IEs) while waiting for COMPLETE.
AMF receives new REG REQUEST (same IEs) while waiting for COMPLETE.
AMF receives multiple REG REQUEST (different IEs) before sending response.
AMF receives multiple REG REQUEST (same IEs) before sending response.
AMF receives REG REQUEST in REGISTERED state from genuine UE.
AMF receives REG REQUEST in REGISTERED state, considers UE not genuine.
AMF receives Mobility/Periodic Update REQ while waiting for COMPLETE.
AMF receives DEREGISTRATION REQUEST while waiting for COMPLETE.
AMF receives REGISTRATION REQUEST with protocol error.
AMF receives REGISTRATION REQUEST with invalid security capabilities.
UE initiates de-registration while registration is ongoing.
UE receives DEREGISTRATION REQUEST while registration is ongoing.
UE receives REG ACCEPT with SOR, integrity check fails, UE attempts service elsewhere.
Lower layers indicate access attempt is barred.
Timer T3346 (congestion backoff) is running.
Timer T3447 (service gap) is running.

edges.description: Trigger: UE needs initial registration (e.g., power on, emergency); Condition: UE is 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
Condition: UE initiates procedure; Action: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST, start T3510
Trigger: Network sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring COMPLETE; Condition: Registration accepted
Condition: REG ACCEPT requires COMPLETE; Action: Reset counter, enter REGISTERED, send REG COMPLETE
Trigger: Network sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT not requiring COMPLETE; Condition: Registration accepted
Condition: REG ACCEPT does not require COMPLETE; Action: Reset counter, enter REGISTERED
Trigger: REG ACCEPT via CAG cell, cell not authorized in new list; Condition: Registration accepted
Condition: CAG cell not authorized, non-CAG allowed OR other CAGs exist; Action: Enter LIMITED-SERVICE, search cell
Trigger: REG ACCEPT via non-CAG cell, CAG-only indicated in new list; Condition: Registration accepted
Condition: CAG-only indicated, no authorized CAGs available; Action: Enter PLMN-SEARCH, select PLMN
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#3, #6, #7); Condition: Registration rejected
Condition: REG REJECT #3/#6/#7; Action: Set 5U3, delete context, consider USIM/entry invalid
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#11); Condition: Registration rejected
Condition: REG REJECT #11 (3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add forbidden PLMN, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Condition: REG REJECT #11 (non-3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add forbidden PLMN, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#12); Condition: Registration rejected
Condition: REG REJECT #12; Action: Set 5U3, delete TAI list, add forbidden TAI, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#13); Condition: Registration rejected
Condition: REG REJECT #13; Action: Set 5U3, delete TAI list, add forbidden TAI, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Condition: REG REJECT #13; Action: Set 5U3, delete TAI list, add forbidden TAI, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#15); Condition: Registration rejected
Condition: REG REJECT #15; Action: Set 5U3, delete TAI list, add forbidden TAI, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#22); Condition: Congestion
Condition: REG REJECT #22 with T3346; Action: Abort, set 5U2, start T3346, enter ATTEMPTING-REG
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#27); Condition: N1 mode not allowed
Condition: REG REJECT #27; Action: Set 5U3, delete context, disable N1, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#31); Condition: Redirection to EPC required
Condition: REG REJECT #31; Action: Set 5U3, delete context, disable N1 (3GPP), enter NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#36); Condition: IAB-node not authorized
Condition: REG REJECT #36; Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add forbidden PLMN/SNPN, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#62); Condition: No network slices available
Condition: REG REJECT #62, some allowed/configured S-NSSAIs OK; Action: Abort, set 5U2, retry with allowed S-NSSAIs
Condition: REG REJECT #62, all S-NSSAIs rejected (not TA issue); Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Condition: REG REJECT #62, all S-NSSAIs rejected (TA issue); Action: Abort, set 5U2, add forbidden TAI, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#72) (non-3GPP); Condition: Non-3GPP access not allowed
Condition: REG REJECT #72 (non-3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, disable N1 (non-3GPP), enter DEREGISTERED
Condition: REG REJECT #72 (non-3GPP), UE chooses PLMN search; Action: Enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#73); Condition: Serving network not authorized
Condition: REG REJECT #73 (3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add forbidden PLMN, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Condition: REG REJECT #73 (non-3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add forbidden PLMN, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#74) (SNPN); Condition: Temp not authorized for SNPN
Condition: REG REJECT #74 (3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add temp forbidden SNPN, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Condition: REG REJECT #74 (non-3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add temp forbidden SNPN, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#75) (SNPN); Condition: Perm not authorized for SNPN
Condition: REG REJECT #75 (3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add perm forbidden SNPN, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Condition: REG REJECT #75 (non-3GPP); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, add perm forbidden SNPN, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#76); Condition: Not authorized for CAG
Condition: REG REJECT #76 (CAG cell), non-CAG allowed OR other CAGs exist; Action: Set 5U3, update CAG, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Condition: REG REJECT #76, CAG-only & no authorized CAGs; Action: Set 5U3, update CAG, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#77) (Wireline); Condition: Wireline area not allowed
Condition: REG REJECT #77 (Wireline); Action: Set 5U3, delete context, enter DEREGISTERED
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#78) (Satellite); Condition: PLMN not allowed at location
Condition: REG REJECT #78 (Satellite); Action: Set 5U3, add forbidden location PLMN, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#79); Condition: UAS services not allowed
Condition: REG REJECT #79, UE retries without UAS; Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter ATTEMPTING-REG
Condition: REG REJECT #79, UE chooses PLMN search; Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#80) (Disaster); Condition: Disaster roaming not allowed
Condition: REG REJECT #80 (Disaster); Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter PLMN-SEARCH, block disaster attempt
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#81) (N3IWF); Condition: N3IWF not compatible with NSSAI
Condition: REG REJECT #81, UE retries; Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter ATTEMPTING-REG
Condition: REG REJECT #81, UE chooses PLMN search; Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#82) (TNGF); Condition: TNGF not compatible with NSSAI
Condition: REG REJECT #82, UE retries; Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter ATTEMPTING-REG
Condition: REG REJECT #82, UE chooses PLMN search; Action: Abort, set 5U2, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (#5) (Emergency); Condition: PEI not accepted
Condition: REG REJECT #5 (Emergency); Action: Enter DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (abnormal cause); Condition: Attempt counter < 5
Condition: Abnormal REG REJECT, counter < 5; Action: Stop T3510, increment counter, start T3511
Trigger: Network sends REG REJECT (abnormal cause); Condition: Attempt counter = 5
Condition: Abnormal REG REJECT, counter = 5; Action: Stop T3510, delete context, start T3502, set 5U2
Condition: Abnormal REG REJECT, counter = 5; Action: Stop T3510, delete context, start T3502, set 5U2
Trigger: T3510 expires; Condition: Attempt counter < 5
Condition: T3510 expires, counter < 5; Action: Abort, increment counter, start T3511
Trigger: T3510 expires; Condition: Attempt counter = 5
Condition: T3510 expires, counter = 5; Action: Abort, delete context, start T3502, set 5U2
Condition: T3510 expires, counter = 5; Action: Abort, delete context, start T3502, set 5U2
Trigger: Lower layer failure/release before response; Condition: Attempt counter < 5
Condition: Lower layer failure, counter < 5; Action: Abort, stop T3510, increment counter, start T3511
Trigger: Lower layer failure/release before response; Condition: Attempt counter = 5
Condition: Lower layer failure, counter = 5; Action: Abort, stop T3510, delete context, start T3502, set 5U2
Condition: Lower layer failure, counter = 5; Action: Abort, stop T3510, delete context, start T3502, set 5U2
Trigger: TAI changes before registration outcome; No condition
Condition: TAI changed before outcome; Action: Abort and re-initiate registration
Trigger: TAI changes after ACCEPT, before COMPLETE; Condition: New TAI is in TAI list
Condition: New TAI is in list; Action: Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE
Trigger: TAI changes after ACCEPT, before COMPLETE; Condition: New TAI not in TAI list
Trigger: REG COMPLETE fails, TAI changes; Condition: New TAI is in TAI list
Condition: New TAI is in list; Action: Resend REGISTRATION COMPLETE
Trigger: REG COMPLETE fails, TAI changes; Condition: New TAI not in TAI list
Trigger: REG COMPLETE fails; Condition: No TAI change
Condition: No TAI change; Action: Re-run procedure (e.g., resend REG COMPLETE)
Trigger: REGISTRATION REQUEST transmission fails; No condition
Condition: REG REQUEST failed; Action: Abort and re-initiate registration
Trigger: Localized service access disabled or validity expired; Condition: In SNPN for localized service
Condition: Localized service not allowed; Action: Abort, release NAS conn, enter LIMITED-SERVICE
Condition: Localized service not allowed; Action: Abort, release NAS conn, enter PLMN-SEARCH
Trigger: T3511 expires; No condition
Condition: T3511 expired; Action: Restart registration procedure if required
Trigger: T3502 expires; No condition
Condition: T3502 expired; Action: Perform T3502 expiry actions (e.g., PLMN selection)
Trigger: UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST; Condition: AMF idle for UE
Condition: REG REQUEST received; Action: Initiate common procedures if needed
Trigger: AMF accepts registration; Condition: REG COMPLETE required
Condition: Registration accepted, COMPLETE required; Action: Send REG ACCEPT, start T3550
Trigger: AMF accepts registration; Condition: REG COMPLETE not required
Condition: Registration accepted, no COMPLETE required; Action: Send REG ACCEPT, enter REGISTERED
Trigger: UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE; Condition: T3550 running
Condition: REG COMPLETE received; Action: Stop T3550, enter REGISTERED
Trigger: AMF cannot accept registration; Condition: Various rejection reasons
Condition: Registration rejected; Action: Send REGISTRATION REJECT
Trigger: Lower layer failure; Condition: T3550 running
Condition: Lower layer failure during T3550; Action: Abort, enter REGISTERED, keep GUTIs
Trigger: T3550 expires (1st-4th time); Condition: No REG COMPLETE received
Condition: T3550 expires (retry); Action: Retransmit REG ACCEPT, restart T3550
Trigger: T3550 expires (5th time); Condition: No REG COMPLETE received
Condition: T3550 expires (abort); Action: Abort, enter REGISTERED, keep GUTIs
Trigger: New REG REQUEST received; Condition: T3550 running, IEs differ
Condition: New REG REQ (diff IEs) during T3550; Action: Abort old, process new REQ
Trigger: New REG REQUEST received; Condition: T3550 running, IEs same
Condition: New REG REQ (same IEs) during T3550; Action: Resend REG ACCEPT, restart T3550
Trigger: Multiple REG REQUEST received before response; Condition: IEs differ
Condition: Multiple REG REQ (diff IEs) before response; Action: Abort old, process new REQ
Trigger: Multiple REG REQUEST received before response; Condition: IEs same
Condition: Multiple REG REQ (same IEs) before response; Action: Continue old, ignore new REQ
Trigger: REG REQUEST received; Condition: AMF in REGISTERED state, UE genuine
Condition: REG REQ in REGISTERED state (genuine UE); Action: Delete old context, process new REQ
Trigger: REG REQUEST received; Condition: AMF in REGISTERED state, UE not genuine
Condition: REG REQ in REGISTERED state (not genuine UE); Action: Maintain existing context
Trigger: Mobility/Periodic Update REQ received; Condition: T3550 running
Condition: Mobility/Periodic REQ during T3550; Action: Stop T3550, progress new procedure
Trigger: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST received; Condition: T3550 running
Condition: DEREG REQ during T3550; Action: Abort registration, progress de-registration
Trigger: REG REQUEST received with protocol error; Condition: e.g., Invalid IE
Condition: Protocol error in REG REQ; Action: Send REG REJECT (#96, #99, #100, #111)
Trigger: REG REQUEST received with invalid security caps; Condition: e.g., No 5GS algorithms
Condition: Invalid security caps in REG REQ; Action: Send REG REJECT
Trigger: UE initiates de-registration; Condition: Registration ongoing
Condition: UE initiates de-reg during registration; Action: Abort registration, perform de-reg
Trigger: Network sends DEREGISTRATION REQUEST; Condition: Registration ongoing
Condition: DEREG REQ received during registration; Action: Abort de-reg, continue registration
Trigger: SOR integrity check fails after ACCEPT; Condition: UE attempts service elsewhere
Condition: SOR integrity fail, attempting service elsewhere; Action: Locally release NAS connection
Trigger: SOR requires PLMN/SNPN change, UE attempts service elsewhere; Condition: After successful registration
Condition: Attempting service on other PLMN/SNPN due to SOR; Action: Locally release NAS connection
